candidate.user_input: Under what conditions can an employee request reimbursement for an approved opportunity cost using the 50% upfront reimbursement option?
candidate.reference: An employee may request reimbursement for 50% of the approved opportunity cost after payment and the remaining 50% upon completion, but this split disbursement option does not apply to travel, hotel, or meal expenses.
reference_contexts:
#### 50% upfront reimbursement

All requests may use the split disbursement option when applicable:

- 50% of the approved opportunity cost can be reimbursed after payment
- the remaining 50% can be reimbursed upon completion

This option does not apply to travel, hotel, or meal expenses.
